description: This file defines the S3MultipartUploadException class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling exceptions related to multipart uploads in Amazon S3. It extends the general MultipartUploadException class and adds methods to access specific details like bucket name, object key, and source filename.

classes.name: S3MultipartUploadException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling Amazon S3 multipart upload errors, providing access to the bucket, key, and source filename involved in the multipart upload failure.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the S3 bucket associated with the failed multipart upload.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the object key associated with the failed multipart upload.

methods.name: getSourceFileName
methods.description: Returns the source filename involved in the multipart upload, if available.

methods.name: collectPathInfo
methods.description: Helps gather bucket, key, and filename information from the CommandInterface object to populate the exception details.
